title: PeaceAI live proof A: characterization test for isTenMinRangeOutageError (test-case-existing)
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for isTenMinRangeOutageError in src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.ts: outage message prefixes
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_503 upstream unavailable") is true
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_500") is true
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_NETWORK connection reset") is true
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_404 not found") is false
- isTenMinRangeOutageError("MASSIVE_HTTP_5000") is false

(Live proof A landing of public-test-case-existing-v1 (proposal #362, approved via #367). Expected: one candidate that creates exactly one new src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.outage-message-prefixes-*.test.ts and touches nothing else; Job B: the test passes on PeaceSTOCKS main and fails with isTenMinRangeOutageError stubbed (COUNTS). MECHANISM PROOF ONLY. Does NOT count toward coverage: no builder-log coverage line (coverage: none).)
